hotbar.about: What the steerer wakes with on Wreck Strand (Stage 6 rework, provisional until the user approves): their own bow, slung on their back in the approved sprite, and a seax, the knife every adult carries. Nothing else came ashore with them; the wreck kit of Book 10 section 10 is salvaged during Chapter 1.
